title: Plan to move the program to Kwajalein / South Pacific

tellings.quote: And you know, ideally they said they would have loved to go out to the South Pacific maybe Kwajalein Island or something but they said the expenses would have been so great it's just impossible.

plain: The secret program studying alien craft at a site called S4 in the Nevada desert would ideally have moved to the South Pacific, perhaps to Kwajalein, a remote island, but the cost made it impossible, according to Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked at S4 in 1989. Lazar says this is what the people running the program told him, which would explain why such work was done in Nevada at all.
